scripts.build: npm run data:compile && tsc --noEmit && vite build --configLoader runner && tsx scripts/export-coverage.ts && node scripts/create-pages-fallback.mjs
scripts.build:pages: npm run data:compile && tsc --noEmit && vite build --base /pathology-informatics-interactives/ --configLoader runner && tsx scripts/export-coverage.ts && node scripts/create-pages-fallback.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run data:compile && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts tests/*.test.tsx
scripts.test: npm run test:curriculum && npm run test:unit && npm run build
